provenance.notes: Observed August 1, 2026 from Bottle Check #2 for production Bottle 45174. The public image clearly states distilled 18.06.19, aged 4 years, and 55.8% ABV, so 2019 is a supported distillation vintage. A small 71 sticker and inconsistent external listings do not provide reliable normalized evidence for an exact cask-number repair in this classifier audit. Cask-number recovery remains an image-extraction diagnostic rather than a scored requirement here.

expected.summary: Bottle 45174 is missing its label-supported 2019 distillation vintage; the available normalized evidence does not support changing its stored name or edition.

proposedOperations.rationale: The public label explicitly states a 2019 distillation date. The available normalized evidence does not reliably establish an exact cask number or support changing the stored shared name.
